description: Cavalry attack at its shipped value (the baseline) and one and two points higher, on the greedy mirror. Every number carries a 95% interval and every non-baseline cell a delta, so the question is whether a one-point buff moves the mirror or the pace by more than the noise, read from the deltas table rather than by eye. What the table showed: it does. Red (the side that moves second) wins one game in five at the shipped value, and each point of cavalry attack closes that first-mover gap by about fifteen points until attack 8 is an even fight; the pace does not move. The assertions pin the even fight at 8 and the steady pace; the interval bound only guards against a re-run with fewer runs.
